excludedSources: The same-species closed-eye source is a blink, not a look substitute.
sourceArtQuestion: Whether a recognizable head/bill attention change remains coherent with the same individual and stationary stance at normal scale.
priorSourceArtHold: Original paired look narrows/reconfigures body and stance; the later look expands the body downward and moves to a broader, lower stance.
currentSourceArtDisposition: AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEWS; no useful look slot gain claimed.
supportQuestion: Actual perch or ground support, anatomical contact and pressure are unapproved and are not solved by a shared crop or positive alpha.
metadataAndPackagingQuestion: Both candidates pass the actual pixel subset after one common zero-only crop of cleaned frames; this is not source-art or full runtime acceptance.
ifSourceArtHoldPersists: Keep exact neutral still fallback. A future matched stance/head key or explicitly reviewed transition may be needed; this batch does not authorize or queue new drawings.
supportDecisionAlternative: An alternate posture may remain a useful labelled still study. A different support context does not automatically repair a quiet-look stance mismatch.
